header.title: How to Replace a Dryer Centrifugal Switch
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to replace a dryer's centrifugal switch. It covers the necessary safety precautions, disassembly, and switch removal and replacement process.

steps.description: Gather the necessary tools and a new centrifugal switch for the dryer repair.
actions: Buy a new centrifugal switch from a hardware or home supplies store.
Record the brand and model information of the dryer.
Collect screwdrivers.
Collect wrenches.
Collect protective gear.

steps.description: Disconnect the dryer from its power source before proceeding with any work.
actions: Switch off the dryer
Unplug it from power outlet

steps.description: Remove the dryer's outer panel to access the centrifugal switch.
actions: Use a screwdriver
Remove the outer panel
Loosen the screws
Carefully lift off the lid
Place the lid in a safe position

steps.description: Remove the rear panel from the dryer using a screwdriver, ensuring screws are stored safely and noting their locations.
actions: Use a screwdriver to remove the rear panel
Place screws from the appliance in a safe location
Take note where each set has been removed
Take a picture before removing parts

steps.description: Access the drum by removing the lint tray and loosening retaining clips.
actions: Dismount the lint tray
Use screws to loosen the component
Place the component in a safe position
Use a putty knife to press the top part of the dryer
Loosen retaining clips

steps.description: This step involves removing the old centrifugal switch, inspecting other dryer components, and preparing for the new switch installation.
actions: Hold down the clips using a putty knife.
Remove the toe panel.
Loosen the screws at the corners of the panel.
Locate the motor.
Remove the old switch.
Inspect other components in the dryer.
Look out for dust or dirt build.
Remove debris using a brush or vacuum.
Check for torn or worn out devices.
Make the required replacements (if necessary).
Replace the drive belt (if necessary).
Oil the motor (if necessary).
Place the new centrifugal switch into position.
Make sure it is fixed properly and secure.
Reassemble the device.
Check whether all devices are fastened in the appliance.
Plug the appliance to a power supply.
Turn on the switch.
